decisive_items: a skin-colored, exophytic, soft, oval tumor with overlying pinpoint vessels and branching telangiectasia
The lesions are composed of mature adipose and fibrous tissues
response.rationale: The clinical presentation of a stable, exophytic flank lesion with pinpoint vessels and telangiectasia since infancy is classic for nevus lipomatosus superficialis, and histology confirms mature adipose and fibrous tissue. Lipofibromatosis typically presents as a deeper, infiltrative mass on distal extremities, not with these surface vascular changes.

rejected.why: Clinical features (telangiectasia, exophytic flank lesion, stability since infancy) are more specific for nevus lipomatosus superficialis; lipofibromatosis lacks these surface vascular findings and has a different typical location.
